text: Gardening involves various essential tasks, including watering, pruning, and planting. Watering is the first step, ensuring the soil remains moist but not waterlogged, while also maintaining the right pH level. The next step is pruning, which is crucial to promote healthy growth and maintain the overall structure of the plants. Pruning involves removing dead or diseased branches, removing long stems, and trimming any weak or damaged leaves. Finally, planting the selected seeds or seedlings requires careful consideration to ensure the best growing conditions, including the right soil type, spacing, and amount of sunlight. All these tasks, when done correctly, can lead to a thriving and vibrant garden.
